summary: Feed s103_single to NDR is degraded due to excessive encryption: 98.6% of bytes are encrypted vs 90% tolerance. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLANs, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy, so traffic is complete and correctly delivered except for payload blindness.

findings.root_cause: Nearly all traffic on this feed is TLS-encrypted (98.6% encrypted bytes) and is being forwarded by the packet broker without decryption or SSL visibility offload. This exceeds the NDR's 90% encrypted tolerance.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection, signature matching, file extraction and behavioral analysis. With 98.6% encryption the tool is blind to payload content and limited to flow metadata only, severely reducing detection coverage for exploits, C2, and lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: Provide selective TLS decryption via a packet broker integrated SSL visibility solution or forward a decrypted copy from a TLS proxy to bring encrypted share below 90%, restoring payload visibility the NDR needs. If decryption is not possible, filter known trusted encrypted flows or route them separately.
